name: Run an administrative operation
description: Executes one administrative operation with the venue's authority. Odin only. Without `user`: one of the venue operations — v/ops/venue/adapters|show-config, v/ops/venue/adapter/enable|disable|configure, v/ops/venue/module/load|unload, v/ops/mcp/add-server|remove-server|refresh|tools-list (the venue's MCP servers), v/ops/user/create|list|info|delete, v/ops/user/authentication-list|revoke, v/ops/ucan/issue|verify (grants over venue-controlled resources), v/ops/p2p/peers|connect, v/ops/secret/list|set|delete (the venue's own secrets), v/ops/brightside/storage (the data store's disk: compaction at the next start, originals kept by repairs), v/ops/brightside/shutdown, v/ops/brightside/restart (the venue stops and starts again inside the app), v/ops/brightside/relaunch (a new instance takes over from this one). user/delete never takes the owner's own account or a user another god keeps. With `user`: runs the operation inside that user's namespace on their behalf (user:sudo, this venue's own users only) — one of v/ops/covia/read|list|inspect|slice|aggregate|write|copy|delete, v/ops/agent/create|list|info|update|suspend|resume|reload-context|sessions|compact-session|rename-session|delete-session|delete, v/ops/skills/list|read|import, v/ops/brightside/delete-skill, v/ops/secret/list|set|delete. Without `user`, v/ops/job/cancel with the `id` of an Inbox request Odin made itself withdraws it, once it no longer needs an answer; no other job. Anything else is refused: answering an Inbox, talking to an agent as its owner, scheduling or running other operations, money, and the venue's own agents. Every run is a recorded job.

operation.description: The full operation path, e.g. v/ops/venue/adapter/enable.

input.description: The operation's own input, exactly as its schema describes.

user.description: Optional: a user DID of this venue. When present the operation runs inside that user's namespace on their behalf, and must be one of the namespace operations.
